comps.label: C2

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; broadband is only a small part.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Alaska-focused integrated carrier led by wireless; it does have fiber and cable broadband, but the business mix is different.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Its TDS Telecom unit is a small-market fiber and cable broadband, video and voice provider with business and wholesale services.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns fiber networks selling consumer and business broadband plus wholesale fiber transport to carriers, closely matching the target's fiber model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Satellite broadband and defense equipment maker; different technology, customers and business model from terrestrial fiber.
